scientific_integrity: Infinite statements proved by exact structural and enumerative arguments. Finite graph-level checks are corroboration only. Known scalar ordinary and connected power-domination numbers are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Applies to labeled rook graphs with both dimensions at least two, standard power domination and induced connectivity; the complete polynomial uses coefficient extraction. No extension to arbitrary products or independent priority certification is claimed.
title: Complete ordinary and connected power-domination enumerators of rook graphs
